litematica_material_tracker.title: Litematica Material Tracker
litematica_material_tracker.description: Live material list HUD overlay, shulker box inventory auto-auditor, and missing block alarms.
litematica_material_tracker.config.gener: Master toggle for all Litematica Material Tracker features.
litematica_material_tracker.config.hud.e: Renders the live material list HUD directly on screen.
litematica_material_tracker.config.hud.p: Screen anchor point for the material list HUD overlay.
litematica_material_tracker.config.hud.x: Horizontal offset in pixels from the anchor point.
litematica_material_tracker.config.hud.y: Vertical offset in pixels from the anchor point.
litematica_material_tracker.config.hud.s: Display scaling multiplier for HUD text and icons.
litematica_material_tracker.config.hud.m: Maximum number of material rows shown in the HUD.
litematica_material_tracker.config.hud.c: Collapse details into a high-density summary HUD.
litematica_material_tracker.config.hud.s: Ordering criteria: Missing First, Total Count, or Item Name.
Render 3D item models next to material entries.
Display an overarching schematic completion progress bar.
litematica_material_tracker.config.hud.b: Alpha transparency for the HUD backdrop.
litematica_material_tracker.config.audit: Inspect all shulker boxes inside inventory and sum nested items.
Inspect player Ender Chest contents and nested shulkers.
Inspect bundle contents in player inventory and ender chest.
Scan nested containers inside bundles or shulkers up to safe depth.
Frequency of background inventory audits (20 ticks = 1 second).
litematica_material_tracker.config.alarm: Play audio alarm when entering placement zone without required materials.
Sound event played when missing material alert triggers.
Volume level for missing item alerts.
Pitch multiplier for missing item alerts.
Minimum seconds between repeated sound alarms.
Trigger warning when available stock is below this percentage.
litematica_material_tracker.config.color: HUD text color when player has all required materials in hand.
HUD text color when items are available in shulkers but not loose.
HUD text color when required items are missing entirely.
Color and alpha transparency of HUD window background.
litematica_material_tracker.config.hotke: Hotkey to open Litematica Material Tracker settings menu.
Hotkey to toggle the material tracker HUD on/off.
Hotkey to instantly rescan all inventories and shulker boxes.
Hotkey to temporarily mute missing material alarms.
